title: GST Officers' Arrest Powers Scrapped, Prosecution Threshold Hiked to ₹5 Crore!
content:
# GST Officers' Arrest Powers Scrapped, Prosecution Threshold Hiked to ₹5 Crore!

Ek important update hai. Government ne taxpayers ko relief dete hue GST officers ki arrest powers ko scrap karne aur prosecution ke liye monetary threshold ko badhane ka big announcement kiya hai. This was a key outcome of the 57th GST Council meeting held on October 8, 2026.

Here’s a quick rundown of the key decisions:

*   **Arrest Powers Removed:** The GST Council has recommended the complete withdrawal of arrest powers under GST by omitting Section 69 of the CGST Act, 2017. This is a significant move towards a more trust-based tax administration.
*   **Prosecution Threshold Raised:** The monetary threshold for initiating prosecution has been significantly increased from ₹1 Crore to ₹5 Crore. This means prosecution proceedings will now be launched only for cases involving higher amounts of tax evasion, offering relief to many businesses.
*   **General Penalty Reduced:** The general penalty, applicable where no specific penalty is prescribed, has been reduced from ₹25,000 to ₹10,000.
*   **Implementation Date:** These process reforms are expected to be implemented from April 1, 2027.

These changes aim to ease compliance, reduce the burden on taxpayers, and make the GST regime more business-friendly.
